svg.text: PostgreSQL 18.6 · 268 SQLSTATE codes in 43 classes · src/backend/utils/errcodes.txt
the same 268 cells in the same 268 positions in both grids, ordered by class then code
Appendix A of the manual gives each code one row: SQLSTATE, condition name. 262 identical rows. (6 codes carry no condition name and are not in it -- dashed.)
ink = log of the number of errcode( ) sites, 1 to 740 · amber = imposed by a form the first rule did not model · struck = no site anywhere, 73 of 268
each class as wide as it is large; the struck part is the codes with no site
73 of 268 codes have no imposition site anywhere in the tree that publishes them. All 73 stand in Appendix A of the manual.
21 are Class HV, the SQL/MED foreign-data-wrapper class, whose own generic code HV000 is one of them. Three classes are wholly siteless: 03, 0B, 0F.
